name: Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge style: Qasr Al Sarab - Moreeb
region: Liwa, Al Dhafra, Abu Dhabi, UAE
author: Rally Raid samples
description: Patterned after the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge (W2RC / FIA round): almost all dunes from Qasr Al Sarab to the Moreeb Dune and Liwa. Realistic: sabkha crossings, a WPV at the famous Moreeb hill climb, WPS at soft sabkha, a road-crossing speed zone into Liwa.
